Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE COMPLETE FULL-SCREEN 16:9 LANDSCAPE GAME UI ARTWORK, edge-to-edge, high resolution. This is a polished final visual design screen for the Chinese two-player papercraft game 《交子赶工记》. NOT a component sheet, NOT a contact sheet, NOT multiple screens, NOT a website, NOT HTML-style minimal cards. The attached 2 images are strict STYLE and CHARACTER references. Match their gorgeous, cheerful, richly detailed miniature paper-diorama finish: creamy fibrous cardstock and folded cut-paper layers, chunky paper thickness, folded tree leaves, soft bevels, warm delicate contact shadows, ivory paper plaques with raised gold double borders and scalloped/stepped corners, restrained Song-era Chinese architectural/cloud-scroll ornament, red ink seals. Saturation as high as the references: brilliant GOLDEN ginkgo foliage, jade grass and turquoise water, clean INDIGO/BLUE roof tiles, honey wood structures, CREAM paper, vibrant CINNABAR red and JADE TEAL accents. Every plant is layered flat papercut leaves, never realistic grass fur. Consistent soft warm lighting from upper left. Charming Song-inspired Chinese craft world, premium finished cooperative videogame. Carefully typeset legible dark-brown Chinese brush-calligraphy titles, readable Chinese UI. No English debug captions, no annotations, no mockup device, no browser chrome, no watermark. Name ALWAYS 交子赶工记, never 交子搭子. Exactly two main characters: 纸团, a happy square-headed paper-hat boy in olive/cream robe with blue details; 印桃, happy brown-haired twin-bun girl in red/cream robe with red ribbons. Match their cute reference designs. Game rules are SINGLE active order and SINGLE sheet held per player, five stations plus a shared table, two drying slots. Do not copy old reference's extra orders, paper stacks in hands or detached floating doors.
SCREEN 1: FULL-PAGE LEVEL SELECT. Match the rich composition of reference image 2 while making this the FIRST LEVEL only. Left roughly 68%: a lush, highly finished isometric papercraft miniature map, curved turquoise stream at lower-left, tiny stone bridge, golden ginkgo trees, sparse green folded-paper foliage, a walled courtyard naturally connected to a blue-roof print workshop; in the courtyard a paper-pulp water vat and a drying stand holding EXACTLY TWO sheets; in workshop print/inking, stamping, delivery and shared table. These are parts of ONE continuous first-level workshop, NOT two separate level nodes. Paper-hat boy holds one papermaking screen at vat; red girl operates the stamp indoors. Pale mountains and Song courtyard rooftops in the distance, layered paper clouds. One beautiful map plaque under the combined workshop: "01 开张第一单" with three EMPTY star outlines. No other selectable stages, no Boss monument, no locked future-stage buttons. Top left small decorative brand plaque "交子赶工记", below it large layered cloud-paper heading "今日去哪开工". Top right two square raised paper buttons with back arrow and gear symbols.
Right roughly 30%: a magnificent thick layered ivory PAPER DETAIL PANEL with stepped/scalloped edges, warm gold double relief trim and subtle paper fibers, like reference image 2. Top title plaque "开张第一单" with red seal-style round "01" badge. Beneath a richly framed vignette of the open print workshop. Then concise process illustrations of a SINGLE paper sheet, ink brush and square red seal, with short clear Chinese heading "抄纸 · 印刷 · 盖印" and small text "双人合作". At bottom two circular cut-paper portrait medallions matching the boy and girl, captions "纸团" and "印桃". Wide imposing cinnabar button at panel bottom with stepped gold key-pattern corners and large ivory lettering "进入工坊". Ensure fully visible button and all panel margins. Bottom-left small cream framed status plaque "首关 · 双人合作". This must feel like a shippable beautiful full game menu, full composition, no empty design-board areas.
